name: Finers-4k-benchmark
description: A financial-domain named-entity recognition (NER) benchmark containing ~4k annotated examples designed to evaluate entity extraction in finance-related text. It measures models' ability to identify and classify financial entities (companies, instruments, monetary amounts, etc.) under domain-specific tokenization and labeling challenges. Useful for assessing domain adaptation and sequence-labeling performance of NLP models in finance.
reputation: Niche dataset used in domain-specific financial NER research but not as widely adopted as general-purpose NER benchmarks.
